title: All for the Show - Death from Above

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: All for the Show - Death from Above is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Let's continue your training. Overcoming any obstacle is great, but don't forget to show your superiority over others. Everyone needs to know you're above your opponent — literally, ha! Can you imagine the crowd screaming in the stands?"

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +9,900 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 55,000 Roubles
- 30 GP coins
- Unlocks B&T MP9 9x19 submachine gun in the Armory
